ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
There exists a magnetic field in space with its direction perpendicular to the plane of the paper (the $xOy$ plane) and pointing inward. In the region where $x \geq 0$, the magnitude of the magnetic induction is $B_{0}$; in the region where $x < 0$, the magnitude of the magnetic induction is $\lambda B_{0}$ (where $\lambda > 1$ is a constant). A charged particle with mass $m$ and charge $q$ ($q > 0$) is injected into the magnetic field with velocity $v_{0}$ along the positive $x$-axis from the origin $o$. The timing starts at this moment, and the gravitational force on the particle is neglected.

1. When the direction of the particle's velocity is again along the positive $x$-axis, what is the time of the particle's motion?
2. When the direction of the particle's velocity is again along the positive $x$-axis, what is the distance between the particle and point $o$?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the vertical y axis divides space into two magnetic-field regions on the left and right. There are crosses on both the left and right sides, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper inward; the right-side region is labeled B0, and the left-side region is labeled λB0. The particle starts from the origin O, with initial velocity v0 along the +x direction, and q>0, λ>1. Reasoning: A positive charge in a magnetic field is subject to the Lorentz force qv×B. The initial velocity is along +x, and the magnetic field is inward, so the force is upward. Therefore, in the B0 region with x≥0, it undergoes uniform circular motion, with radius R1=mv0/(qB0). The center of the circle is in the positive direction of the y axis. The particle first travels along the right semicircle, and when it returns to the y axis, its velocity becomes the -x direction. The time used is half a period: t1=πm/(qB0), and at this time the position height is 2R1. After entering the x<0 region, the magnitude of the magnetic field is λB0, and the radius becomes R2=mv0/(qλB0)=R1/λ. At this time the velocity is along -x, and the magnetic field is still inward, so the Lorentz force is downward. Therefore, the particle travels along a semicircle on the left side, and when it returns to the y axis again, its velocity is along +x. The time used for this semicircle is t2=πm/(qλB0). Therefore, the total time when it again moves along the +x direction is t=t1+t2=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q). The final position is on the y axis, and the height is 2R1-2R2=2mv0/(B0q)(1-1/λ), so the distance to point O is this height.

method.method_draft: Use a geometric circular-arc construction. First read the diagram: the y-axis is the boundary between two magnetic-field regions, with crosses indicating field into the page; the right side is labeled B0 and the left side is labeled λB0, and the particle starts at O with velocity v0 along +x. From the text, q>0 and λ>1. Apply the Lorentz-force direction rule: for v along +x and B into the page, the force is initially upward, so in the x≥0 region the particle moves on a circle of radius R1=mv0/(qB0) centered on the +y-axis. It completes a right semicircle and returns to the y-axis with velocity along −x after time πm/(qB0), at height 2R1. Then in the x<0 region the radius is R2=mv0/(qλB0)=R1/λ; with velocity −x the magnetic force is downward, so it moves through a left semicircle and reaches the y-axis again with velocity +x after time πm/(qλB0), at height 2R1−2R2. Add the two semicircle times and take the distance from O as the final y-coordinate: t=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q), d=2(R1−R2)=2mv0/(B0q)(1−1/λ).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中竖直的 y 轴把空间分成左右两个磁场区域，左右两侧都有叉号，表示磁场垂直纸面向里；右侧区域标注为 B0，左侧区域标注为 λB0。粒子从原点 O 出发，初速度 v0 沿 +x 方向，且 q>0、λ>1。

推理：正电荷在磁场中受洛伦兹力 qv×B。初始速度沿 +x，磁场向里，所以受力向上，因此在 x≥0 的 B0 区域中做匀速圆周运动，半径 R1=mv0/(qB0)。圆心在 y 轴正方向上，粒子先走右半圆，回到 y 轴时速度变为 -x 方向，所用时间为半个周期：t1=πm/(qB0)，此时位置高度为 2R1。

进入 x<0 区域后，磁场大小为 λB0，半径变为 R2=mv0/(qλB0)=R1/λ。此时速度沿 -x，磁场仍向里，洛伦兹力向下，所以粒子在左侧走一个半圆，再次回到 y 轴时速度沿 +x。该半圆所用时间为 t2=πm/(qλB0)。

所以再次沿 +x 方向运动时的总时间为 t=t1+t2=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q)。最终位置在 y 轴上，高度为 2R1-2R2=2mv0/(B0q)(1-1/λ)，因此到 O 点的距离就是这个高度。

method.method_draft: Use velocity-angle evolution and displacement integration rather than drawing circle centers. Read from the image that the particle first lies in the right half-plane with field B0 into the page, then crosses to the left half-plane where the field is λB0 into the page; the initial velocity arrow at O points along +x. From the text, q is positive and the speed remains v0 because the magnetic force does no work. In a uniform B into the page, the velocity direction rotates counterclockwise at angular speed ω=qB/m. In the right region, starting from angle 0, the particle remains in x≥0 until its velocity angle reaches π; this takes Δt1=π/ω1=πm/(qB0). Its vertical displacement over this interval is ∫0^{π/ω1} v0 sin(ω1 t)dt=2v0/ω1=2mv0/(qB0), with zero net x-displacement. In the left region, the angular speed is ω2=qλB0/m; the velocity angle advances from π to 2π, taking Δt2=π/ω2=πm/(qλB0). The vertical displacement over this half-turn is ∫0^{π/ω2} v0 sin(π+ω2 τ)dτ=−2v0/ω2=−2mv0/(qλB0), again ending on the y-axis with velocity angle 2π, i.e. +x. Sum the times and vertical displacements to get t=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q) and distance from O equal to 2mv0/(B0q)(1−1/λ).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是 xOy 平面，原点 O 在坐标轴交点处，x 轴向右，y 轴向上。整幅图用叉号表示磁场垂直纸面向里。y 轴右侧标注磁感应强度为 B0，y 轴左侧标注为 λB0。原点 O 处有粒子初速度箭头 v0，方向沿正 x 轴。
推理：粒子带正电 q>0，磁场向里，磁力不做功，所以速率始终为 v0。在均匀磁场中，速度方向以角速度 ω=qB/m 逆时针转动。右半平面 x≥0 中 B=B0，所以 ω1=qB0/m。粒子从速度角 0 转到 π 时仍在右半平面，并到达 y 轴，所用时间 Δt1=π/ω1=πm/(qB0)。该半周的位移为 Δx1=∫v0 cos(ω1t)dt=0，Δy1=∫v0 sin(ω1t)dt=2v0/ω1=2mv0/(qB0)。随后进入左半平面，磁场为 λB0，角速度 ω2=qλB0/m。速度方向从 π 转到 2π 时再次沿正 x 轴，所用时间 Δt2=π/ω2=πm/(qλB0)。这一段位移 Δx2=0，Δy2=∫v0 sin(π+ω2τ)dτ=-2v0/ω2=-2mv0/(qλB0)。因此总时间 t=Δt1+Δt2=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q)。最终位置仍在 y 轴上，相对原点的竖直位移为 2mv0/(B0q)-2mv0/(λB0q)=2mv0/(B0q)(1-1/λ)，因为 λ>1，所以这就是到原点的距离。

图像描述：图中是 xOy 平面，原点 O 在坐标轴交点处，x 轴向右，y 轴向上。整幅图用叉号表示磁场垂直纸面向里。y 轴右侧标注磁感应强度为 B0，y 轴左侧标注为 λB0。原点 O 处有粒子初速度箭头 v0，方向沿正 x 轴。
推理：粒子带正电 q>0，磁场向里，磁力不做功，所以速率始终为 v0。在均匀磁场中，速度方向以角速度 ω=qB/m 逆时针转动。右半平面 x≥0 中 B=B0，所以 ω1=qB0/m。粒子从速度角 0 转到 π 时仍在右半平面，并到达 y 轴，所用时间 Δt1=π/ω1=πm/(qB0)。该半周的位移为 Δx1=∫v0 cos(ω1t)dt=0，Δy1=∫v0 sin(ω1t)dt=2v0/ω1=2mv0/(qB0)。随后进入左半平面，磁场为 λB0，角速度 ω2=qλB0/m。速度方向从 π 转到 2π 时再次沿正 x 轴，所用时间 Δt2=π/ω2=πm/(qλB0)。这一段位移 Δx2=0，Δy2=∫v0 sin(π+ω2τ)dτ=-2v0/ω2=-2mv0/(qλB0)。因此总时间 t=Δt1+Δt2=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q)。最终位置仍在 y 轴上，相对原点的竖直位移为 2mv0/(B0q)-2mv0/(λB0q)=2mv0/(B0q)(1-1/λ)，因为 λ>1，所以这就是到原点的距离。

raw_record.original_question:
There exists a magnetic field in space with its direction perpendicular to the plane of the paper (the $xOy$ plane) and pointing inward. In the region where $x \geq 0$, the magnitude of the magnetic induction is $B_{0}$; in the region where $x < 0$, the magnitude of the magnetic induction is $\lambda B_{0}$ (where $\lambda > 1$ is a constant). A charged particle with mass $m$ and charge $q$ ($q > 0$) is injected into the magnetic field with velocity $v_{0}$ along the positive $x$-axis from the origin $o$. The timing starts at this moment, and the gravitational force on the particle is neglected.

1. When the direction of the particle's velocity is again along the positive $x$-axis, what is the time of the particle's motion?
2. When the direction of the particle's velocity is again along the positive $x$-axis, what is the distance between the particle and point $o$?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the vertical y axis divides space into two magnetic-field regions on the left and right. There are crosses on both the left and right sides, indicating that the magnetic field is perpendicular to the paper inward; the right-side region is labeled B0, and the left-side region is labeled λB0. The particle starts from the origin O, with initial velocity v0 along the +x direction, and q>0, λ>1.

Reasoning: A positive charge in a magnetic field is subject to the Lorentz force qv×B. The initial velocity is along +x, and the magnetic field is inward, so the force is upward. Therefore, in the B0 region with x≥0, it undergoes uniform circular motion, with radius R1=mv0/(qB0). The center of the circle is in the positive direction of the y axis. The particle first travels along the right semicircle, and when it returns to the y axis, its velocity becomes the -x direction. The time used is half a period: t1=πm/(qB0), and at this time the position height is 2R1.

After entering the x<0 region, the magnitude of the magnetic field is λB0, and the radius becomes R2=mv0/(qλB0)=R1/λ. At this time the velocity is along -x, and the magnetic field is still inward, so the Lorentz force is downward. Therefore, the particle travels along a semicircle on the left side, and when it returns to the y axis again, its velocity is along +x. The time used for this semicircle is t2=πm/(qλB0).

Therefore, the total time when it again moves along the +x direction is t=t1+t2=(1+1/λ)πm/(B0q). The final position is on the y axis, and the height is 2R1-2R2=2mv0/(B0q)(1-1/λ), so the distance to point O is this height.
